instruction: I want to enable 'always on top' for VLC video window so it stays above other windows even when I click on other applications. How can I configure VLC to always stay on top?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
